title: DataIntegrityProof
description: Formal spec REQ-6-7. One W3C Data Integrity proof (https://www.w3.org/TR/vc-data-integrity/), ecdsa-jcs-2019 cryptosuite. Every operation carries one or more of these in its own `proof` array -- a proof set, each checked independently against the operation's own unsecured content. `verificationMethod` is either `<did>#key-0` for an ordinary signer (ward, guardian, or registrar), or a self-contained `did:key:<multikey>#<multikey>` for an operational key proving possession of itself (REQ-7.1-8/REQ-7.2-12).
